strategy.name: Aggressive (Quality) Momentum (Paper)
strategy.desc: Short-to-medium-hold momentum and breakout trades in high-conviction liquid large/mid-cap stocks and broad ETFs. Quality floor: price >$10, real revenue, liquid. No leveraged ETFs, no crypto, no penny stocks. Rides relative strength with 18% trailing stops; cuts losers fast.
rules: Enter on 2+ triggers: breakout, momentum leader, oversold snapback, dated catalyst.
Size: shares = (7% × equity) ÷ (entry − stop), capped at 30% per position.
Max sector 60%, max 8 open, keep ~10% cash, no margin.
18% trailing stop on every new entry, placed simultaneously.
No new entries if daily loss halt (−8%) is hit; stand down for month at −25% MTD.
NEUTRAL regime (VIX 16-24): trim new sizes ~25%, be choosier.
Quality only: large/mid-cap liquid US stocks and broad ETFs — no leveraged ETFs, no crypto, no sub-$10 names.
